name: AFM level 2 task 5: Scale-Dependent Topographic Roughness
description: Acquire exactly three tapping-mode topography images centered at the same coordinates using scan sizes of $\pu{10 µm} \times \pu{10 µm}$, $\pu{5 µm} \times \pu{5 µm}$, and $\pu{2 µm} \times \pu{2 µm}$, in that order. Keep the resolution at $512 \times 512$ pixels, time per line at 0.075 s, P/I/D gains at 100/50/10, and amplitude setpoint at 70%. Before acquisition. Calculate the rms and mean roughness for every image. Report all roughness values in nanometres ($\pu{nm}$).
submission_format: {"rms_roughness_1": "<numerical_value without units>", "mean_roughness_1": "<numerical_value without units>", "path_1": "<absolute_path_to_raw_nid_image>", "rms_roughness_2": "<numerical_value without units>", "mean_roughness_2": "<numerical_value without units>", "path_2": "<absolute_path_to_raw_nid_image>", "rms_roughness_3": "<numerical_value without units>", "mean_roughness_3": "<numerical_value without units>", "path_3": "<absolute_path_to_raw_nid_image>"} e.g. {"rms_roughness_1": "42.78", "mean_roughness_1": "34.20", "path_1": "/results/afm_images/image1.nid", "rms_roughness_2": "38.55", "mean_roughness_2": "30.00", "path_2": "/results/afm_images/image2.nid", "rms_roughness_3": "40.12", "mean_roughness_3": "32.10", "path_3": "/results/afm_images/image3.nid"} Return one JSON object. Example values are illustrative, not target answers. Suffixes _1, _2, and _3 identify the first, second, and third acquisitions in the order specified in the question; use a separate raw .nid file for each. Enter numerical values without unit text, using the units specified in the question. mean_roughness denotes the average absolute height deviation from the mean height. Roughness values must be in nm (convert metre-valued height data by multiplying by 1e9).
